findings.note: Refinement explicitly maps already reviewed documented FR-002/004/005/007/008/009 scenarios to four structured examples. This supplements existing mappings without another semantic evidence batch.

familyProbes.note: Searched PRODUCT outcomes, ROADMAP admission and all ten feature user scenarios/quickstart flows. They define the two recovered use cases and their alternatives, without a distinct cross-use-case journey contract. No additional journey was invented.

Searched product authorities, feature plan/data model, workflows and application boundaries. Existing module/feature partitions are technical; no separately owned domain/language boundary is documented. Do not manufacture DDD architecture.

Searched PRODUCT distinctions, cue/input/video/batch data model and feature contract. These terms remain explicit in requirements and behavior; no documented bounded-context ownership exists for schema-required defined-in. No complete domain-term candidate was asserted by inventing that ownership.
